product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native supply-chain planning, modeling, and decision-intelligence platform for large enterprises managing complex supply chains.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing URL returns only a permanent redirect and does not show public pricing.

employee_band.notes: The company describes a 300+ person team.

founded_year.notes: Lyric’s structured company-information page says 2021; its company page describes its founding team assembling in 2022, so the public sources are inconsistent.

eng_blog.notes: Its archive includes multiple technical posts on platform architecture and optimization methods; the authors’ engineering job titles are not explicitly given.

public_docs.notes: The documentation site presents an email sign-in/access gate rather than public product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open Applied AI / GTM Engineer posting is an applied-AI technical role, not an AI-sales title.

model_provider.notes: Lyric names these as foundation models it combines with its forecasting methods.

last_funding.notes: The current company information page reports a $55.5M Series B; the dated August 2025 announcement initially reported $43.5M for that round.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced in August 2025, within the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive position is listed as open.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable recent blog history showed technical/analyst content, including an August 2026 forecasting article, but no dated product or major-feature launch announcement in the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small company team page identifies its founder/CEO and other leaders; I found no announcement of a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the stated period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A GTM engineering job post names Salesforce in Lyric’s internal GTM stack.
